findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dynomatix_list_open_positions, dynomatix_get_position, dynomatix_get_work · Private data: dynomatix_submit_application, dynomatix_list_work, dynomatix_about · Public sink: dynomatix_submit_application, dynomatix_submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dynomatix_list_open_positions, dynomatix_get_position, dynomatix_get_work · Private data: dynomatix_submit_application, dynomatix_list_work, dynomatix_about · Public sink: dynomatix_submit_application, dynomatix_submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
